> An unrelated question: Is cbsmodel is the same as that (cbs)
> implemented in DNAcopy ? From the loaded packages, I can see DNAcopy
> package. When i ran DNAcopy independently (by supplying values
> externally in a tsv), on the same samples that I used in aroma
> affymetrix, for segmentaion, CBS (in DNAcopy) took forever (more than
> 48 hours).

Yes, The CbsModel class is using the segment() method of DNAcopy - so
you get the same performance and identical results as if you do it
manually.

Note 1: CbsModel applies CBS chromosome by chromosome and *that is
much faster* than doing on the whole genome at once. Results should
not differ too much.

Note 2: Starting with DNAcopy v1.19.2, the algorithm is much(!) faster
than before. You can install that version by:

source("http://www.braju.com/R/hbLite.R");
biocLite("DNAcopy", rver="2.10.0");

/Henrik
